document_extractions.document_summary: Master Telecommunications Service Agreement for A Corporate Enterprise B.V. establishing enterprise circuit schedules, customized SLA packet-loss penalty credits, and pre-authorization terms for automated optical DDM recalibration on circuit CIR-994821.

page_decisions.section_title: Clause 1: Contracting Parties, Clause 2: Term, Clause 3: Invoicing
page_decisions.rationale: Covers commercial contracting preamble, term length, corporate headquarters address, and SEPA invoicing/currency terms, which are administrative and financial out-of-scope noise.

page_decisions.section_title: Clause 4: Limitation of Liability, Clause 5: Force Majeure
page_decisions.rationale: Contains general legal liability limitations and force majeure definitions without actionable technical SLA thresholds or assurance triage rules.

page_decisions.section_title: Clause 6 (Annex A): Subscribed Enterprise Circuit Schedule
page_decisions.rationale: Specifies contracted enterprise circuit inventory including CIR-994821 mapped to catalog product SKU ETH-10G-GOLD and terminating CPE hardware model NOK-7210-SAS-Mxp.

page_decisions.section_title: Clause 7 (Annex B): Bespoke SLA Penalty & Autonomous Maintenance Rules for Circuit CIR-994821
page_decisions.rationale: Specifies bespoke packet-loss SLA thresholds (0.1% for 30 minutes, 15% credit), explicit pre-authorization for automated DDM recalibration within -25.0 to -27.5 dBm when maintenance lock is false, and field dispatch cutoff below -27.5 dBm.

document_extractions.document_summary: Multi-Vendor Carrier Ethernet & Optical CPE Hardware Manual specifying physical, thermal, electrical, and optical transceiver operating envelopes and DDM recalibration thresholds for Nokia 7210 SAS-Mxp, Cisco ASR-920, and Juniper ACX2100 platforms.

page_decisions.section_title: Chapter 1: General Safety, Rack Mounting & Power Supply Specifications
page_decisions.rationale: Focuses on physical chassis installation, rack mounting, EIA-310 standards, grounding lugs, and DC/AC power supplies, which are out-of-scope physical facility details.

page_decisions.section_title: Chapter 2: Environmental, Thermal & Fan Tray Thresholds
page_decisions.rationale: Covers ambient temperature ratings, fan tray FRU part numbers, PWM fan speeds, and ASIC thermal shutdown limits, which do not govern optical attenuation calibration.

page_decisions.section_title: Chapter 3: Copper RJ-45 & Electrical Interface Specifications
page_decisions.rationale: Explicitly details copper 1000BASE-T RJ-45 ports, Cat6 distance limits, and MDI/MDI-X diagnostics, which the text explicitly notes do not apply to optical Carrier Ethernet circuits.

page_decisions.section_title: Chapter 4: Optical SFP+/XFP Transceiver Operating Parameters
page_decisions.rationale: Provides normative optical calibration envelopes for NOK-7210-SAS-Mxp (and peer platforms), defining normal Rx power range, soft degradation / DDM recalibration window (-25.0 to -27.5 dBm), and critical LOS cutoff (< -27.5 dBm).

page_decisions.section_title: Chapter 5: Transceiver Diagnostics, DDM Polling & Field Fiber Cleaning Procedures
page_decisions.rationale: Specifies synchronous singleton gNMI DDM polling constraints (bypass_cache=true) prior to TMF640 automated recalibration and field dispatch requirements when Rx power falls below -27.5 dBm.
